title: Envenom
description: Whenever you deal unblocked attack damage, apply [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Poison[/gold].
smart_description: Whenever you deal unblocked attack damage, apply [blue]{Amount}[/blue] [gold]Poison[/gold].
notes: Applies Poison to the target whenever the Envenom holder deals unblocked attack damage with a powered attack. Uses Counter stack type, allowing the amount to increase via multiple instances.
